description: Create pixel characters and their animations with PixelLab.
longDescription: Generate pixel art, production-ready eight-direction characters, and official PixelLab skeleton animations directly from the Image node. Connect a reference image whenever a model supports or requires one.
example.1: Create a 32-bit fantasy ranger pixel-art character with a transparent background.
example.2: Use the attached character reference to create a running animation.
config.apiKey.description: Stored by the PixelLab plugin and sent only to api.pixellab.ai.
nodes.createCharacter.title: Create character
nodes.createCharacter.description: Creates an official PixelLab character with four or eight directions.
nodes.skeletonAnimation.title: Skeleton animation
nodes.skeletonAnimation.description: Creates a character, then asks PixelLab to animate it with skeleton-v3.
nodes.pixen.title: Pixen pixel art
nodes.pixen.description: Creates native-resolution pixel art from a description.
